items.title: Cursor市集出現惡意Claude Code擴充套件，攻擊者企圖建立SSH後門
items.summary: AI程式碼編輯器業者Cursor近日公告，旗下擴充套件市集在10月29日出現遭植入惡意程式碼的Claude Code for VS Code擴充套件，攻擊者企圖在開發人員電腦建立SSH後門。受影響版本為2.1.312及2.1.313，可能有多達5,000名使用者受影響。惡意版本上架約11小時後遭到下架。

items.title: Infisical募資4,000萬美元，擴展AI代理憑證保護與存取管理
items.summary: 美國資安業者Infisical宣布完成4,000萬美元B輪融資，公司估值達6億美元。Infisical將利用本輪募資所得持續開發既有產品，並加碼投入AI代理安全產品的研發。

items.title: Linux基金會旗下AAIF新增4項AI代理開源專案，涵蓋沙箱隔離與技能共享
items.summary: Linux基金會（The Linux Foundation）旗下代理型AI基金會（Agentic AI Foundation，AAIF）新增4項開源專案，包括Anthropic的Agent Skills、OpenAI的Open Responses、Hugging Face的OpenEnv，以及阿里巴巴的OpenSandbox。

items.title: 數發部訂定通訊傳播控制系統資安防護基準，2027年元旦生效
items.summary: 營運技術資安資訊分享與分析中心（OT-ISAC）近期盤點亞太地區關鍵基礎設施與營運技術（OT）資安政策變化，其中提到數位發展部已針對依《資通安全管理法》納管的通訊及傳播領域關鍵基礎設施提供者，訂定控制系統資安防護基準。根據數發部9月16日公告，這項新制將於2027年1月1日生效。

items.title: fix(exec): preserve no-timeout results from macOS app nodes (#190729)
items.summary: fix(exec): preserve no-timeout results from macOS app nodes (#190729) Supersedes #185434, thanks @etzelm. ## What Problem This Solves Fixes: commands on macOS app nodes lose their result after 20 seconds when `exec` requests `timeoutSeconds: 0`. ## User Impact User impact: no-expiry commands can return their output after 20 seconds. Gateway invocation bounds, cancellation, configured policy, finite timeout caps, and explicit socket deadlines remain in effect. Delivery requires a macOS app build with the updated bundled node runtime; no Team Gateway deploy is needed for the fix itself. ## Why This Change Was Made The Gateway normalizes zero to `timeoutMs: null`, which Swift already executes without a process timer. The socket client must distinguish an omitted timeout (`undefined`, retaining its 20-second default) from explicit zero or null. This repairs that decision at the existing owner without changing Swift or execution policy. The existing socket tests now cover null alongside zero and verify that an explicit finite socket deadline still overrides null. Production LOC delta: 0; test LOC delta: 0. No new machinery or test harness was needed. ## Evidence - Exact-head [PR CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/41365038582) and the required `openclaw/ci-gate` pass for `a908e6808cdc25fdc3e3c42f4791952831c1f1ae`, including changed-test lanes, type/lint checks, baseline ratchets, and security checks. - Main checked at `71becfa19f32a86eb3e62bccf713f5be7107884f`: traced exec timeout resolution → Gateway zero-to-null normalization → node-host forwarding → socket response deadline → Swift nil timeout handling. - Red before: the null case in `src/infra/jsonl-socket.test.ts` fails on main because a response timer is installed (1 failed, 15 passed; wrapper 2.59 s). - Green after: `pnpm test src/infra/jsonl-socket.test.ts src/infra/exec-host.test.ts --maxWorkers=1`: 17 passed, wrapper 1.76 s. The real Unix socket receives output after a simulated day; explicit 50 ms override, finite command budgets, omitted default, and cancellation retain coverage. CI timing is reported by the PR checks. - Touched-file lint, format check, and `git diff --check` pass. - Independent local autoreview (Codex, P0–P2, final local snapshot against the main SHA above): scoped-clean, no actionable findings. It reviewed the changed files plus the Gateway, node-host, exec timeout, and Swift callers; it did not execute tests. - Baseline failure retained: the additional `src/infra/exec-host.socket.test.ts` run fails in the malformed matching response case with `read ECONNRESET` at its peer cleanup assertion. The same failure reproduces with the unmodified main socket owner (1 failed, 7 passed). Its finite 5,000 ms command and explicit 1,000 ms response budget are unchanged by this patch; other sibling cases pass. Socket reset behavior remains an investigated baseline uncertainty, not a passing check. - Local node-host test preparation began compiling the broader worker bundle and was stopped to respect production-host limits. PR CI owns node-host and broad proof. This Linux host has no macOS toolchain; no native app execution or Swift build is claimed. The TypeScript transport regression does not prove native process cancellation. - Contributor code was read through `gh pr view` / `gh pr diff` only and was never checked out, installed, built, or run. This replacement was implemented independently on main and credits Mitchell Etzel in the commit. Co-authored-by: Mitchell Etzel

items.title: fix(computer): preserve field and browser typing whitespace (#190594)
items.summary: fix(computer): preserve field and browser typing whitespace (#190594) fix(computer): keep meaningful whitespace in set_value and browser_type text The computer-use request builder trimmed the text payloads of `set_value` and `browser_type`, so leading, trailing or whitespace-only text was changed before it reached the app or the page. These two actions now send the text exactly as given. ASCII text, explicit empty values and the `type` action are unchanged. `browser_dialog` is not changed here: its prompt step could not be exercised on Linux, and the receipt is on the PR. Evidence: built Gateway with real admitted agent turns on managed Linux X11/CUA (with #190700) and Chromium, main twice and candidate twice. Mixed and whitespace-only text was trimmed on main and kept with this change, checked by reading back the Mousepad saved file for `set_value` and the Chromium DOM for `browser_type`. ASCII, empty and `type` controls were unchanged. Details: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/190594#issuecomment-6565424242. Thanks @huidongchen148. Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
